changelog: Vortex v4.4.2: Fixes the broken v4.4.0/v4.4.1 releases, whose installers shipped the previous build's files under a new version number - PyInstaller had refused to overwrite a non-empty output directory and the build script mistook the leftover executable for a successful build. This release is the first to actually deliver the v4.4.x work: rebuilt live match tracker (rounds won/lost, live KDA/HS/ADR, premade party detection), agent auto-lock reliability fix, auto-updater relaunch fix, forced borderless launch, and a copyable settings profile for crosshair/sensitivity/keybinds/video across accounts.
